advancement.celestweaks:decided_by_desti: Mortal or immortal, all things acknowledge your claim to divinity...
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.false_transce: 'What does freedom really mean, when demanded of you by a god?'<br2/>...was it your destiny, that brought you here? Or did you carve this path with your own two hands, until the principles of this reality could deny you no longer?<br2/>The universe smiled upon you, and whether by fate or through

your suffering, wove the Heart of Creation into form, for you alone to wield. A spellstone to transcend all others, a spark of divinity that the gods above kindle into powers beyond imagination.<br2/>But you sense no divine will nor arrogance within this Heart, just a pure

manifestation of the world's essence, untainted by the so-called precepts of heaven. Interestingly enough, this event has granted you insight into the mysteries of the cosmos - knowledge that even the gods cannot easily obtain... or perhaps, knowledge that the gods would seek to bury away.<br2/>At last you understand. Though a demigod, you were unquestionably mortal, at least up until this point. And now you understand a truth -

that the gods are cruel, that the endless torture and toil of demigods just like you in pursuit of immortality is merely their divine comedy. For they know that none could approach them - and those who do are struck down by divine restraint, never to reach ascension.<br2/>But with the Heart of Creation in hand, you will be the exception - an enemy of the divine, made unshakeable, undying by primordial will

reality. Will you rend heaven apart, bring justice to the souls damned by their hand? Or absolve the heavens of sin, and live in peace, unbound by divinity? That answer you must decide for yourself. But whatever you choose, know that it shall not be imposed by immortals, or woven by the threads of fate. For you are free at last, and the choice shall be yours alone.<br2/>The universe whispers to you one final word - §kYuheng§r
